# Cloudflare Workers configuration for Kape Norte
# Docs: https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers/wrangler/configuration/

name = "kape-norte"
main = ".output/server/index.mjs"
compatibility_date = "2026-09-01"
compatibility_flags = ["nodejs_compat"]

[assets]
directory = ".output/public"
binding = "ASSETS"

[observability]
enabled = true

# --- Public runtime variables ---
# These are NOT secret (the publishable key is already visible in your site's
# browser code), so declaring them here makes them reliably available to the
# Worker's server code. Without these lines the site builds fine but every
# page fails at runtime with "supabaseUrl is required".
[vars]
SUPABASE_URL = "https://fcqfxuxgfhkeweugzpab.supabase.co"
SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY = "sb_publishable_FIFxTwE5JdCeVGOQmDs7Qw_hJCd-Y-H"

# --- Secrets (do NOT put values here) ---
# Optional - only needed for the admin dashboard and places-sync routes:
#   npx wrangler secret put SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
#   npx wrangler secret put PLACES_SYNC_TOKEN           (protects /api/public/sync-places)
#
# The VITE_* values are baked in at build time from your .env file, so build
# locally with the same .env before running `npx wrangler deploy`.

# --- Custom domain ---
# Add kapenorte.dpdns.org in the Cloudflare dashboard:
#   Workers & Pages > kape-norte > Settings > Domains & Routes > Add > Custom Domain
# (the zone for dpdns.org must be active on your Cloudflare account first)
